mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.25% compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime-specific conditions.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.0 percentage points signals weak labor market conditions that suppress consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and retail sales indicate robust consumer demand that drives corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, rising industrial production signals strong manufacturing momentum that supports corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances during late-cycle expansion when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% triggers expectations of monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Positive quarterly GDP growth rate indicates strong economic expansion that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without triggering conditions.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances when GDPC1 growth rate is positive, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in non-farm payrolls and decreases in unemployment rate signal a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, rising federal funds rates signal reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs that suppress equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances during monetary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
